description: Rb₂NaMoBr₆ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. Rb is bonded to twelve equivalent Br atoms to form RbBr₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent RbBr₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent RbBr₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NaBr₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent MoBr₆ octahedra. All Rb-Br bond lengths are 3.92 Å. Na is bonded to six equivalent Br atoms to form NaBr₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MoBr₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent RbBr₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-Br bond lengths are 2.92 Å. Mo is bonded to six equivalent Br atoms to form MoBr₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaBr₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent RbBr₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Mo-Br bond lengths are 2.61 Å. Br is bonded to four equivalent Rb, one Na, and one Mo atom to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing BrRb₄NaMo octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-60°.
